title: Numerical analysis of parabolic equations with Prandtl--Ishlinskii hysteresis of play type
summary: Rigorous error analysis for numerical approximations of parabolic equations with hysteresis remains limited, even for the widely used Prandtl--Ishlinskii model of play type. In this work, we establish an $O(h+τ)$ error bound for an implicit Euler $P_1$ finite element discretization. The analysis requires neither higher-order temporal regularity nor additional spatial regularity of the hysteresis variables.
